column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: cleat#4083. The test loops registeredBackends and runs three cases per dialect against a real schedule store; postgres RUNS in this PostgreSQL-only job and the mysql and mssql arms skip, 3 cases x 2 dialects = 6, counted by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set. The multi-DB job runs all three.
dialect-gated per SUBTEST: the cluster job runs ./engine/... against a PostgreSQL-only database too, so the same six arms skip here. See the test-go/engine line.

cleat#4083: the test loops registeredBackends and runs three cases per dialect against a real schedule store, so a job that sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL runs its own arms and skips the other two dialects' three cases each = 6, counted BY NAME from a report of that shape (every skip event, subtests only; the parent does not skip). Written as a specific ^Test... line so it leaves the broad /postgres$ and /mssql$ pools alone, as cleat#4092 does.
